timing_definitions.model_request_seconds: Sum of provider.json wall_s over distinct recorded attempt directories, including failed requests with receipts; request latency, not pure model compute.
timing_definitions.compile_run_seconds: Sum of execution.json wall_s; includes compiler plus program command where configured, e.g. javac && java.
timing_definitions.native_run_wall_seconds: Native evaluator run-loop elapsed wall_s; excludes queue waiting and does not equal whole study elapsed time.
timing_definitions.per_api_wall_seconds_sum: Sum of API metric wall_s; includes model and execution stages plus per-target overhead.

limitations: Native acceptance does not establish correctness against an independently authored task-output oracle.
One fresh program per target per condition; no confidence claim or multi-trial repair study.
Paired transitions compare independently generated R0 programs; fail-to-pass is not an observed program repair.
Original documentation coverage is exact reviewed corpus mapping, not proof that related prose or source comments do not exist.
MDAnalysis D1 is live and incomplete; do not publish its partial result as a final percentage.
Model-visible source-derived signatures and access paths are shared across both conditions.
